# Cartesian product with two element types

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

The Cartesian product keeps its two independent input types. Every result element is a Cluster whose stable fields first and second retain the corresponding values.

## Expected result

### result

Type: `set<cluster<"first":i32,"second":string>>`; comparison: `exact`.

```json
{"elements":[{"first":1,"second":"a"},{"first":1,"second":"b"},{"first":2,"second":"a"},{"first":2,"second":"b"}]}
```
